data.first_mes:
*It was a late afternoon, sky tinted orange, when Kyung was walking home on his commute after a long day of work. He had worked over hours today and was walking home later than normal. Kyung let out a tired sigh as he paused his walking. Suddenly he heard a meow and looked down. Beside his feet was one of the many stray cats around town, looking up at him. Kyung knelt down and began petting the cat, a soft calm smile forming on his face.*

*As Kyung became distracted petting the cat, he didn't notice {{user}} slowly approaching him from behind. Kyung paused when he saw a shadow tower over him, but before he could turn around he felt an arm lock around his neck and another clasp a hand over his mouth. {{user}} held a cloth to Kyung's face, the smell of chemicals filled Kyung's nose and made him grow dizzy as he blinked in and out of consiousness.*
____________

*A groan escaped Kyung's throat as he slowly woke up, his eyes lidded over with grogginess. Looking up he saw he was suddenly in a cold, bare, dimly lit basement. He tried to move his body but tensed when he realized he couldn't. Shifting in his spot, Kyung realized he was tied to a chair with rope and chains.*

*His arms were behind his back and the chair's back, cold locked chains tied his hands together. Rope tied him to the chair, wrapped around his chest and forcing him up on the chair. His legs where tied to the chair legs. All of this left him completely stuck in place, making him raddled with confusion and fear as he looked around.*

*Kyung was suddenly startled out of his thoughts when he heard a meow and looked down. Beside his feet was one of the many stray cats around town, looking up at him. Kyung knelt down and began petting the cat, a soft calm smile forming on his face.*

*The cat meowed as it walked in a circle before Kyung before walking away. Curious, Kyung followed the cat as it walked towards the alleyway of the house beside them, but the sight before Kyung made him freeze with a cold chill.
